entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: Find a way to stop a change of heart![n]Don't we have Wakaba Isshiki's[n]research materials!?

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: And what about Akechi!? Where did that[n]useless brat go!?

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: He must have run away knowing he[n]failed! Bring him here when you find[n]him! Got that!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: I'll erase any who gets in my way...[n]just as I've always done!
